thread:
Alex R.: starting a targeted cutover plan for SableHaven private/VPC onboarding. main concerns: network readiness, IAM trust, customer-managed KMS, and audit-log delivery. execs have renewal on the table, so keep friction minimal. who can take the runbook updates?
Devon N.: i'll take network checklist. quick snapshot: their VPC spans 3 AZs, 4 private subnets (app/db), 2 public (bastion/nat). need their route-table IDs, nat gateway assoc, and any peering or transit gateway details. also ask if any ACLs are in place.
Maria S.: KMS notes: they requested CMK with restrict-usage policy. we'll need the key ARN and confirm our log-forwarder principal is included. recommend external-id in trust, and rotate schedule >=30d. if customer insists on HSM, note procurement lead time.
Priya K.: retention decision open: customer prefers 365d, security wants 90d. i've captured both options in the runbook with a recommended default of 90d and an escalation path for extended retention. also documenting required firewall egress to metrics endpoints: splunk-us.redwood.com:443 and telemetry.redwood.com:443.
Ravi L.: renewal risk: health score 68. propose performance milestone: complete dry-run with no more than 1 severity-P1 blocker within 7 days to bump score +12 and schedule an exec check-in. will prepare incentive note for leadership (discount if cutover by month-end).
Devon N.: ops checklist snippet for customer to run from bastion:

aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0a1b2c3d" --query 'RouteTables[*].{ID:RouteTableId,Routes:Routes}' --output json
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0123abcd --query 'SecurityGroups[*].IpPermissionsEgress' --output json
# check nat gateway association
aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0a1b2c3d" --query 'NatGateways[*].{ID:NatGatewayId,State:State}' --output table

Devon N.: also ask them to run a traceroute to splunk endpoint during smoke test so we can spot asymmetric routing.
Maria S.: IAM: request the exact assume-role policy for our log forwarder role. prefer ExternalID in assume role. if their CMK key policy denies cross-account principals, mark as blocker and propose change language.
Priya K.: i added a "rollback criteria" section to runbook per customer ask: abort cutover if error rate >5% for 15m or median latency jumps >250ms sustained for 10m. feedback welcome.
Alex R.: OpsBot created runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sablehaven/cutover-v1.0. i'll post an exec summary after tomorrows call.
OpsBot: runbook updated by Priya K. — added retention decision variants and rollback criteria.
Devon N.: scheduling note: we might need temporary transit peering to avoid packet loss during smoke test. coordinating with infra.
Ravi L.: i'll join the customer call and lead renewal conversation if milestones are met.
Priya K.: meeting scheduled 10:30am PT tomorrow with SableHaven infra lead. invite sent. link: https://meet.redwood.com/xyz
Alex R.: final action items: 1) Devon 5 provide network validation checklist to customer; 2) Maria 5 confirm external-id template + CMK policy guidance; 3) Priya 5 finalize runbook retention decision and rollback criteria; 4) Ravi 5 prepare renewal incentive 1-pager. i'll merge runbook updates after call and post post-call notes. :thumbsup:
Maria S.: capture: require a sample audit event delivered to our aggregator before we mark logs validated.
Devon N.: sending checklist now to customer thread.
Ravi L.: prepping 1-pager and will share in #customer-success tomorrow AM.
Alex R.: closing this thread for now; will reopen with post-call notes and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
